### Forest {#review-app-2}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      12 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Aug 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Surgef_, Aug 22, 2026, 1/5: "I had been using Forest for a while but the app is notoriously buggy and can cause a lot of delays/issues. I had app issues where I was overcharged multiple times due to bundles not working and rides not ending and it is impossible to get an answer from customer service. I would recommend not using Forest and instead using Lime as a much more reliable bike app."
            2. _jokal3112_, Aug 11, 2026, 1/5: "Absolute worst customer service I've ever experienced. My bike was broken, so I couldn't end the ride — the timer just kept running. I then tried every way possible to reach support: emailed 5 times (no response), called twice (couldn't get through), tried live chat twice (it's frozen), and even the email address listed on the website is no longer a working address. Not a single contact channel actually works. On top of that, I regularly lose minutes from my 1,200-minute subscription to broken bikes, and reported bugs never get reimbursed. I had to buy an extra 500-minute bundle, which is now being drained by the exact same issue. The referral bonus I was promised for friends who signed up also never showed up. An app you can't actually reach anyone through when something goes wrong isn't usable. Can't recommend this right now."
            3. _app reviewer aak_, Aug 6, 2026, 1/5: "Used it for a month and generally had a decent experience with their bikes. However, the app is very buggy, and can sometimes not end your ride properly resulting in an overcharge. I have tried contacting support multiple and they haven’t got back to me, nor have they even acknowledged receipt of my issue. I think they just hope you dont notice these charges and over time, give them more money that you dont owe them. Cancelled my subscription to them and switched back to Lime."
<!--/ir-theme-->

### Forest: Focus for Productivity {#review-app-4}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**

         **Review examples:**
            1. _suzicatherine_, Aug 19, 2026, 1/5: "Harder to use and regularly freezes since the recent update. The whole point is that I should not have to focus on what I’m doing - not think about the app & deal with it crashing. Counterproductive."
            2. _TDTW!_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "The 2026 redesign is clearly meant to promote the paid subscription model and not for ergonomics. The post-session is now multiple screens showing among other unhelpful analytics the option to watch ads to boost reward. The new interface is buggy, slow, bloated, and often unresponsive. Useful features (e.g. adjusting focus time) are hidden behind unnecessary menus. The pay-to-unlock trees are background noise, but you can't ignore the constant nagging to watch ads or pay. The old interface was good precisely because it's minimalistic. I hope paid users can have the option to revert to the old interface. For other frustrated users: you can still use the interface if you turn on plant together. Apparently this feature will be removed once the new interface officially launches. I hope the developers have the decency to leave it in."
            3. _Manthan Parmar_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "I don't know why the app is so lagging since a long time and the makers are doing nothing also this latest update is the worst update I had ever seen, multiple skips till to reach the home page every single time.. useless enginners"

### Notion: notes, tasks, AI {#review-app-6}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      9 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Aug 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _.oliviaaa_, Aug 15, 2026, 1/5: "There's a lot of issues on mobile compared to the desktop version. For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete. Sometimes even when you hold down the delete button, a letter or two doesn't get deleted. It's generally laggy and without a premium subscription, you can't even upload a single video as the file max is 10mb and most videos are over that. You have to find a site and register to embed the videos instead. Overall greedy platform. Used to be good until it became buggy and you're can't upload a video without the app's premium subscription being shoved down your throat."
            2. _AS-QV_, Aug 13, 2026, 1/5: "Lot of bugs like emoji selection failures, Formatting text on the phone. Notion used to be the minimalist note taking app with seamless UX. Now, it's like any other tech company. Product is pushing to add more features for the cost of reduced usability to boost internal KPIs. Save Notion or I'm out to Obsidian!"
            3. _narwhalez123_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "Was a big fan of this app a couple of years ago, i find the organisation so satisfying. I re-downloaded it recently and the lag and ai-centric design has really made it into one of the worst note taking apps i have ever used! You can’t do anything without the screen freezing and it feels like it’s just turned into a generic ai chatbot app with a little bit of organisation on the side (that doesn’t even work most of the time??) it’s so disappointing to see and I hope the creators import an ai-free version for notetakers who actually think for themselves, perhaps the lack of ai will make some of the other features less laggy."
